review_note: Local material review records the exact source case and keeps cross-repository execution claims gated.

levels.label: Line-level detection
levels.status_display: Accepted Anti-Slop finding at an exact source line
levels.allowed_claim: Anti-Slop can report the selected generic-stat-label candidate with a rule, line, rationale, and safe direction.
levels.forbidden_inference: The candidate is a confirmed defect without human review, or every generated-code problem is covered.

levels.label: Changed-file enforcement
levels.allowed_claim: The target flow requires Pre-CR to run the adapter against the changed-file set and retain an attributable blocking receipt.
levels.forbidden_inference: Pre-CR has already blocked this case, or a passing receipt is merge approval.

levels.label: Repository context
levels.status_display: Quality Runner consumption not yet captured
levels.allowed_claim: The target flow assigns Quality Runner the canonical finding, repository context, and remediation order.
levels.forbidden_inference: Quality Runner has consumed this finding or deduplicated it in a current run.

levels.label: Failure and fallback states
levels.allowed_claim: The stack contract distinguishes plugin unavailable, analysis failure, advisory fallback, and dual-source deduplication.
levels.forbidden_inference: The fallback matrix has passed in an integrated execution.

levels.label: Local material package
levels.status_display: Candidate case, preview, and page source reviewed
levels.allowed_claim: A local candidate packet contains the bounded case, claim ledger, candidate 16:9 preview, and no-auth page source.
levels.forbidden_inference: The page is hosted, public, or posted to any destination.
